# Financial Analyst Guide

> Free CFA study guides, practice questions, and exam preparation resources for all CFA levels.

Financial Analyst Guide provides comprehensive, free study materials for the Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) certification program. The site offers detailed guides, practice questions, formulas, and learning resources across all CFA levels, supported by the Mastery exam prep app available on iOS and Android platforms.

## Key Topics

- CFA Level I
- CFA Level II
- Exam Preparation
- Practice Questions
- Study Guides
- Financial Analysis
- Portfolio Management
- Chartered Financial Analyst
- Free Resources
- Spaced Repetition
- Ethics
- Quantitative Methods
- Fixed Income
- Derivatives
- Valuation

## CFA Study Programs

- [CFA Level 1 Essentials](https://financialanalystguide.com/cfa-level-1-essentials): CFA Level 1 essentials study guide covering ethics, quant, economics, FSA, equity, fixed income, derivatives.
- [CFA Level 1](https://financialanalystguide.com/cfa-level-1): Comprehensive CFA Level 1 study guide with curriculum volumes, topic summaries, formulas, practice questions.
- [CFA Level 2 Essentials](https://financialanalystguide.com/cfa-level-2-essentials): CFA Level 2 study guide covering valuation, FSA, fixed income, derivatives, alternatives, portfolio management.

## Getting Started

- [Home](https://financialanalystguide.com): Homepage offering free CFA Level I & II study guides, notes, formulas, and practice questions.
- [About Financial Analyst Guide](https://financialanalystguide.com/about): About page describing FinancialAnalystGuide.com mission, resources, and Mastery exam prep app.
- [FAQ](https://financialanalystguide.com/faq): FAQ addressing questions about study guides, practice questions, apps, coverage, and study workflow.
